viewer_sees: three enormous hands closed around the rim of a battered bronze war helmet, three flat river pebbles tumbling in the bowl of it, ash still drifting past

the colossal Titan seated in a hall that only reaches his knee; then one continuous move up his own body — from the old scarring across his open hands in his lap to the hollowed face above them, the eyes cut away to one side
SILHOUETTE — the Titan a flat black shape against a firelit doorway, head tipped back, a small bundle lifted above his mouth; no detail, no blood
PROCESS CUTAWAY — the Titan's torso opened like a chamber, five full-grown gods standing alive in the dark of it at five heights, each lit only by a faint glow of their own

the Cretan cave — a woman kneeling with a newborn while her free hand folds a blanket over a river-worn stone; then the same cave with the infant alone on its floor and the sunlit slopes far beyond him
a grown god near-camera with one hand raised, the Titan doubled over enormous above him
six newly grown gods standing wet and unmarked on the flagstones, and at their feet the grey stone that came up first
CROWD AS TEXTURE — two vast armies from overhead as two interlocking grains of bodies, the seam between them churning and never moving
a lone figure on a bronze threshold at the lip of a bottomless shaft, the gate swung wide, huge shapes stirring in the mist below
the forge — three one-eyed smiths hammering over one anvil, a spindle of white-gold light taking shape under the blows and steadying into a finished weapon
a hundred-armed giant filling the frame edge to edge, rank after rank of arms whipping forward, whole boulders leaving the hands like gravel
ANIMATED MAP — the whole cosmos engraved on a bronze disc, sky, sea and underworld, the light travelling across every cut line and finding no division anywhere
three brothers in a tight ring, the battered helmet held out between them, one hand going into the bowl

PROCESS CUTAWAY — the universe in three stacked tiers in one frame: open sky at the top, the sea cut open in the middle, the grey underworld beneath, one brother small in each and a different motion in every band
ordinary green country — fields, a road, a village — with Olympus standing right in the middle of it, and not one boundary stone or marker anywhere in the frame
the three brothers from behind, far apart along the same terrace edge, each looking at something different
Zeus alone against open sky, the thunderbolt hanging forgotten at his side, his attention somewhere else
MACRO OBJECT — two strangers' right hands gripped at the wrist across a worn stone threshold, road dust on one of them
the thunderbolt lying alone on bare marble, a soot handprint from the forge still on it, nobody holding it
Poseidon waist-deep in open sea, the whole horizon his, and his face set wrong for a man who won
Poseidon rounding on a small winged messenger at his shoulder with the trident coming up across his chest; then the same water with the trident let down into it and the messenger already leaving
MACRO OBJECT — two open papyrus rolls side by side, the same six figures drawn in each, the order of them reversed from one roll to the other
Hades alone on the bank of the black river, grey asphodel around him, solid rock where a sky should be
EMPTY AFTERMATH — twelve stone seats in a ring, all twelve taken, and beyond the last one only open cloud where a thirteenth was never cut
a shut sanctuary overgrown to the doorstep with no name cut anywhere on it; then the inside — one priest alone in an empty cell, the door a bright slot of daylight
the same god in the same stance, but the light comes up warm from the ground under him and the grey turns to gold on him

LEDGER — an open palm holding a silver nugget, a lump of gold and one grain of barley; then the ground itself cut open, silver and gold seams running down into the dark while a seed at the top sends one shoot up into daylight
Hades on a plain dark throne, the whole cavern behind him faintly glittering with metal in the rock
CROWD AS TEXTURE — a column of faceless grey figures moving from the near edge of frame into the far dark, no end to it in either direction
the three tiers one more time, wide, with the green band of common earth bright in the middle of them
EMPTY AFTERMATH — three long shadows thrown across bare Olympian marble by figures standing outside the frame, the stone in front of them unworn and unclaimed
the battered helmet from the opening, upside down and empty, three pebbles lying apart from it on the ash
END CARD — the three brothers in one frame against deep sky, sea and dark
